title: Cover nose and mouth
prompt: What should you use to cover your nose and mouth during a fire?
hint: The safety text says to cover your nose and mouth with a soft cloth.

ja.prompt: 火事のとき、鼻と口を覆うために何を使うべきですか？
ja.hint: 本文では鼻と口を布で覆うと書かれています。

local.prompt: 發生火災時，你應該用什麼遮住口鼻？
local.hint: 本文說要用布遮住口鼻。

local_pron.prompt: Fāshēng huǒzāi shí, nǐ yīnggāi yòng shénme zhēzhù kǒubí?
local_pron.hint: Běnwén shuō yào yòng bù zhēzhù kǒubí.

zh.prompt: 发生火灾时，你应使用什么遮住口鼻？
zh.hint: 文本中提到用布遮住口鼻。

en.prompt: What should you use to cover your nose and mouth during a fire?
en.hint: The text says to cover your nose and mouth with a cloth.

en_pron.prompt: What should you use to cover your nose and mouth during a fire?
en_pron.hint: The text says to cover your nose and mouth with a cloth.

title: Crosswalk safety
prompt: What should you do before you cross at a crosswalk?
hint: The safety advice says to wait until cars have stopped before crossing.

ja.prompt: 横断歩道を渡る前に何をすべきですか？
ja.hint: 本文では車が止まるのを待つようにと書かれています。

local.prompt: 在斑馬線過馬路之前你應該做什麼？
local.hint: 文本說要等車停下再過馬路。

local_pron.prompt: Zài bānmǎxiàn guò mǎlù zhīqián nǐ yīnggāi zuò shénme?
local_pron.hint: Běnwén shuō yào děng chē tíng xià zài guò mǎlù.

zh.prompt: 在斑马线过马路前你应该做什么？
zh.hint: 文本建议在车停下后再过马路。

en.prompt: What should you do before you cross at a crosswalk?
en.hint: The advice is to wait until cars have stopped before you cross.

en_pron.prompt: What should you do before you cross at a crosswalk?
en_pron.hint: The advice is to wait until cars have stopped before you cross.

title: Never use the elevator
prompt: What should you never use when leaving a building during a fire?
hint: The fire safety text clearly warns: never use the elevator.
sample: You should never use the elevator.

ja.prompt: 火事で建物から逃げるとき、決して何を使ってはいけませんか？
ja.hint: 本文では決してエレベーターを使わないと注意されています。
ja.sample: エレベーターを使わない

local.prompt: 在火災中離開建築物時，你絕對不應該使用什麼？
local.hint: 文本明確警告：切勿使用電梯。

local_pron.prompt: Zài huǒzāi zhōng líkāi jiànzhúwù shí, nǐ juéduì bù yìng gāi shǐyòng shénme?
local_pron.hint: Běnwén míngquè jǐnggào: qièwù shǐyòng diàntī.

zh.prompt: 火灾时离开建筑物时你绝对不应该使用什么？
zh.hint: 安全文本明确警告：绝对不要使用电梯。

en.prompt: What should you never use when leaving a building during a fire?
en.hint: The safety text clearly warns: never use the elevator when escaping.
en.sample: You should never use the elevator.

en_pron.prompt: What should you never use when leaving a building during a fire?
en_pron.hint: The safety text clearly warns: never use the elevator when escaping.
en_pron.sample: You should never use the elevator.
